## Purpose
Display metadata for background runs: a label and icon per kind and per status, output names, elapsed formatting, and opening a run.

## Responsibilities
- `RUN_KIND_META` and `RUN_STATUS_META`.
- `runOutputName(run)` gives the tool, agent or workflow produced.
- `formatElapsed`.
- `useOpenRun()` navigates to the page that shows a run and requests that it opens there (`useRunUiStore.requestOpen`).

## Key elements
`RUN_KIND_META`, `RUN_STATUS_META`, `runOutputName`, `formatElapsed`, `useOpenRun`.

## Control flow
Pure helpers plus one hook.
